title_zh: 名单之外的人，路还在不在
title_en: The People Left Outside the List
deck_zh: 平台有申诉机构，不证明问题有人能管；福利名单少了人，也不证明生活得到了保障。制度的说明，要一直走到那个人实际还有什么路。
deck_en: An appeals body does not prove effective review, and a shorter benefits list does not prove better protection. Follow the arrangement through to the routes people can actually use.
body_zh: “不满意，可以不在这里卖。”虚构的通衢市集这样回答一家小作坊。话没有假到让人无话可说：作坊确实能关店，也确实关了。可一年后，营业额只剩原来的三成。门是开着的，离开是不是仍算一条可用的路？
在这个故事里，通衢既提供市场，也卖自己的商品。同类商品价格与评分接近，自家品牌却更常上首页；只有用自家物流，才能进入“快送”栏。平台不只是一个参与竞争的卖家，还安排了别人怎样参加竞争。这里的公司与数据均为设例，不是对现实平台的调查结论。
有人主张把市场与自营分开，防止一边定规则一边参赛；有人提醒，自家物流与商品可能改善服务，不能不看效果一律禁止。两边抓住的，都不只是情绪。可即使消费者买得更便宜，也还没有答完卖家能不能问规则；结构有冲突，也不自动说明拆分是唯一答案。
先看绕不绕得过去。名义上还有别的平台，不等于那些地方接得住他的生意。要查真实的替代、迁移与生计条件。越接近不可绕开的地方，越需要强的约束与追问；离得远一些，也不是从此不用负责。
再看谁能关门。暂停账号、推迟结算、取消入口，可能让一家人的生活突然停住。这样的决定不能成为一个位置独占、别人永远不能再问的终点。有管理权限，不等于把收窄权限与处理异议的权力也全部握在一起。
第三看问到哪里。在故事里，申诉委员会七人中有五人由管理层任命。仅凭这个来源，还不能断定没有独立性；要查谁能启动，启动后有什么实际效力，平台能否撤人、断经费、扣资料、取消审查，或报复提出问题的人。
第四看平台能给别人定多大的规则。排序、准入、结算与申诉，落在许多人的生活上；它可以就哪些事项立规、立到哪里，应当有制度划出的范围，不由它自己单方面扩张。不是每一条经营规则都要事先报批，而是不能自己决定自己权限的全部边界。
后来，通衢董事会把两个由卖家互选的申诉席位，也改成管理层任命。人员安排可以修订，不等于修订的通道也可由被问者单独把持。别处是否仍有独立、能发动、不受报复的路，要实际找到，不能用“架构调整”把它省掉。
照这四样看，议会删掉请求拆分的条款，本身不足以断定失职。保留排序公开与独立申诉，也不足以证明问题已经解决。若这两项实际做不成所需的约束，就继续问缺在哪里；不能把一种工具的名字，当作结果已经发生。
拆分可以是手段，但在这里被放在最后：较轻的安排不足，或有充分根据认为它们做不成这些条件，才动用，并说明处理哪一处封路、损失什么、有什么替代。无需先让四项都已实现才能拆，也不必等再受一次伤害；否则“最后”就成了永远不会到的以后。
这些原则偏向事前安排，却没有替每个平台报出“拆”或“不拆”。这确实不是争论者想要的全部答案。具体效果、网络联系的损失与工具的代价，仍要认真算；留给具体制度做的事，不是免做，只是不假装一个总原则已替它做完。
市场之外，另一张名单正等着人。青窑在虚构故事里关闭两条窑线，裁掉九百人。州劳动厅提供失业金、可任选的培训补贴，以及迁居和创业支持；不要求进入指定行业。基金会给得更多：三年生活费，但要进入它的设计园，从它定的三条路里选。
后者还写了不得去其他瓷器企业工作的条件。这项禁止去向，须照前篇的底线独立审，不能被较多生活费遮过去。单看园区与培训条件能否自愿接受，也要先查：拒绝以后，基本生活是否仍有实际着落。州另列一份支持，还没有证明每个人都已被托住。
救济附不附条件，两边也都有能说出来的理由。一边说，分享社会产出就应作贡献；另一边说，人需要说不的力量。若这点生计最后换成必须走别人指定的路，钱虽然来了，方向却一并交走了。
这里先不把领取者理解成欠了一份回报。基本保障不因他还没交出成就，就失去根据。若财政、执行与具体安排确实做得到，无须附条件更好；做不到时，可以讨论某些通用要求，但只是对现实困难的让步，不是让人在道德上先还债。
“做不到”也需要证据。附上条件以后，有限的资源是否真正接住了该接住的人，要看实际。把仍有需要的人挤出名单，账上省了一笔，不叫保障改善。财政能不能办到，与附上的条件有没有越线，要分开核；困难不发放越线许可。
登记求职、接受相当工作、学习或培训，可以作为具体讨论的通用要求；做哪行、学哪项，仍要有人自己可选。纸面列了好几类，手边实际却只有一条路、拒绝就失去全部保障，那并没有保住选择。
基本保障薄，不推出要求可以越来越多。保障多厚，也不能独自决定能否无条件给付；财政与执行条件都要核。方向是把条件做得更能托住人，尽可能不再要求，不是等人穷到走不动了，才把他安排得更紧。
现在看九百人中的一位。设想他的母亲失智，他留在镇上照护她。州的续领规则只列登记求职、上学与培训。他没有求职，也没在上课，按名单便不合格。可他每天正在做的事，为什么在这里忽然不算了？
照护是他自己选择的一条往下走的路，也是实际的工作。有无工资，并不决定它是不是“做”。他维持另一个人的生活与尊严，恰恰在承担基本保障本来要接住的事；若条件是为了让有限资源托住人，这种工作尤其不该被列举漏掉。
社区里的工作也一样。没有雇佣合同，不等于没有工作；没有工资条，也不等于没有经济贡献。承认这些，不是给他补发一张“值得领救济的好人”证，而是改掉一份太窄的名单：原来它把有价值的活动，错认成了什么也没做。
把照护与志愿活动算作参与，并非新的发明。已有的参与收入讨论，就试着把有酬就业之外的活动纳入。在这里，基本保障仍不以报答社会为根据；相同的一项活动，可以被认真承认，而不把领取资格重新绑回他欠了别人多少。
认得宽，不代表事情自动好办。照护怎样记录，做不到怎样认定，争议由谁复核，都会产生新的工作。认可机构不能又把门缩到只剩它安排的那一种活动。文字里有几个选项，还要核人是否真的够得着。
生病、残障或一时实在什么都做不了的人，不能因无法满足活动要求而失去基本保障。条件只向实际能做到的人问。若一整类人都够不着，问题是条件没有给出，不该逼他们每人单独证明自己为什么例外。
规则漏到的个别处境，需要有人现场判断；制度自己造出的缺口，则由制度说明并修正。不能把全部修补责任塞给申请者，再夸赞少数人终于申诉成功。需要帮助的人已经在承担生活，不该还替坏规则永久承担额外的一份。
同样，不能只凭“背景不公”四个字，就替每一个人预先判定任何条件都不适用。做不做得到、条件本身合不合边界，要具体看；已经越线的条件先改，不能要求照办。没有被名单接住的人，也不能因此被放下。
平台与福利看起来很远，却让同一个问题浮出来。平台说有申诉机构，得继续问它够不够得着决定；福利说有领取标准，得继续问它有没有接住生活。组织提供了一个名称，不等于人的路已经在。
这组讨论不给每一场争论一锤定音。它也不保证结构一展开，所有人就认同。利益需要算，规则需要划，个案需要判断；更没有从暂未在文献中看到同样说法，就推出自己首创、已经解决的问题。
那位店主关上店铺，那位窑工坐在母亲床边，可能都暂时没有报表期待的成绩。不能因此把他们压成一句“可以选择”或“不合条件”。要做的，是走到那句话后面，看他还能离开什么，保有什么，又有没有机会自己决定下一步。
body_en: You can sell elsewhere, the fictional Crossways marketplace tells a workshop. The owner does leave. A year later its turnover is thirty percent of the earlier level. The door was open. Whether departure remained a usable route requires another question, not repetition of the permission.

Crossways hosts a market and sells its own goods. Its brands appear more often on the front page when comparable products have similar prices and ratings. Only its logistics users enter the fast-delivery section. The platform arranges how others compete while competing itself. These details belong to a constructed case, not an investigation of a real company.

One argument favors separating hosting from commerce; another warns that integrated logistics and products may improve service. Neither is merely emotional. Lower prices would not settle whether sellers can question rules. A structural conflict does not alone establish that separation is the only adequate response. Both the concern and the remedy require precision.

First examine practical unavoidability. Other platforms on a list may not be able to receive the workshop's business. Alternatives, transfer costs, and livelihood need investigation. The closer an arrangement comes to an unavoidable passage, the stronger its constraints and answerability should be. Distance from that point is not complete immunity.

Second examine closure. Account suspension, delayed settlement, or lost access can stop a household's livelihood. No economic position should monopolize the final authority to close every route. Managing a service does not confer exclusive control over limiting that management or handling every objection to it.

Third examine inquiry. Five of seven appeal-committee members are appointed by management in the story. That origin does not alone establish dependence. Who can initiate? What practical effect follows? Can the platform remove people, withdraw resources, withhold evidence, cancel review, or retaliate against those who begin it? Functional relations matter.

Fourth examine rule-making scope. Ranking, admission, settlement, and appeals structure many people's lives. Institutional arrangements should define what the platform may regulate and how far, rather than leave the entire boundary to unilateral revision. This does not require advance approval of every operating rule. It prevents the rule maker from exclusively defining the whole reach of its authority.

Crossways later converts two seller-elected appeal seats into management appointments. Structures can change, but the challenged party should not exclusively control the route for challenging that change. An independent, usable, nonretaliatory channel must actually exist somewhere. Calling the revision a restructuring cannot substitute for locating it.

Removing a legislative request to initiate separation does not by itself prove dereliction. Retaining ranking disclosure and independent appeals does not prove success either. If those measures cannot secure the necessary constraints, ask what remains missing. The name of an instrument cannot serve as evidence of its accomplished effect.

Separation remains available, but as a last instrument here: lesser arrangements are insufficient, or adequate grounds show they cannot establish the required conditions. Explain the obstruction addressed, costs, and alternatives. The conditions need not already be achieved before separation, nor must another injury occur first. Otherwise last would quietly become never.

These requirements favor advance arrangements without issuing a universal split-or-do-not-split answer. That leaves part of the requested policy answer unfinished. Competitive effects, network benefits lost, and practical costs still need calculation. Work assigned to concrete institutional design is not excused; a general principle simply cannot pretend to have already performed it.

Elsewhere, another list awaits people. In the fictional case, Bluekiln closes two kiln lines and dismisses nine hundred workers. The labor department offers unemployment support, optional training assistance, relocation support, and a small business loan without assigning an industry. A foundation offers more: three years of living costs, conditional on entering its design park and choosing among three prescribed paths.

The foundation also prohibits work for other porcelain firms. That prohibition requires separate examination under the previous essay's boundary; a generous stipend cannot conceal it. Even the training-path condition requires checking whether refusal leaves basic subsistence genuinely secure. A second state package on paper does not establish that every individual's needs are met.

Conditional relief brings serious arguments on both sides. One invokes contribution in return for sharing social output; another defends the power to say no. If subsistence ultimately requires accepting someone else's prescribed direction, money has arrived together with a transfer of authority over where life can go.

Do not begin by treating a recipient as owing repayment for being supported. Basic protection does not lose its grounds because achievement has not been supplied. Where fiscal and administrative conditions genuinely permit support without requirements, that is preferable here. Some general conditions may address demonstrated feasibility difficulties, not discharge a prior moral debt.

Infeasibility needs evidence. After requirements are imposed, do limited resources actually protect those who need them? Removing still-needy people saves money without proving better protection. Feasibility and permissible conditions are separate inquiries. Constraints on a budget do not issue permission to cross the boundary governing what may be demanded.

Job search, suitable work, education, or training can enter discussion as general requirements, leaving an actual choice of activity. Several categories on paper do not establish options in practice. If only one route remains and refusal removes every basic protection, direction has still been assigned from outside.

Thinner support does not justify heavier demands. Thickness alone cannot determine whether unconditional support is feasible; fiscal and administrative arrangements matter too. The direction is toward protection that can require less, not toward tightening control when someone becomes too poor to move. A practical concession is not the desired destination.

Consider one of the dismissed workers. His mother has dementia, and he stays in town to care for her. Imagine that renewed assistance lists only registered job search, education, and training. He is doing none of those. Why should what fills his days suddenly count as doing nothing?

Care is an actual activity and a path he has chosen. Payment does not determine whether it is work. He sustains another person's life and dignity, undertaking something basic protection itself is meant to secure. If conditions aim to make limited resources sustain people, this work particularly deserves recognition rather than omission.

Community work belongs in the same reconsideration. No employment contract does not mean no work; no pay slip does not mean no economic contribution. Recognition should not become a certificate that this is a morally deserving recipient. It should correct a list that confuses valuable activity with inactivity simply because it is unpaid.

Recognizing care and voluntary activity as participation has precedents in participation-income discussions; no discovery is claimed here. The grounding still matters. Support is not repayment for contribution. An activity can be recognized seriously without making a person's basic eligibility depend on a new account of how much they owe society.

Broader recognition does not make administration effortless. Recording care, recognizing inability, and reviewing disputes require work. The recognizing body must not narrow eligibility until its own prescribed activity is the only accepted form. A broad list still needs a check on what people can actually reach.

Illness, disability, or temporary inability to act cannot erase basic protection because an activity condition cannot be met. Conditions address those actually able to meet them. If an entire class cannot reach them, the conditions have not been provided; every member should not have to obtain an individual exception to the same institutional gap.

Particular circumstances left uncovered need judgment. Gaps produced by the institution need institutional explanation and correction. Assigning all repair to applicants, then celebrating the few successful appeals, shifts an additional burden onto people already carrying difficult lives. A bad rule cannot permanently make its subjects responsible for fixing it one by one.

Nor should a broad description of structural injustice predetermine that every conceivable condition is inapplicable to every individual. Examine actual ability and the condition's boundary. An impermissible requirement must be changed, not fulfilled first. Someone missed by the list must not lose basic protection while those questions are being resolved.

Platforms and benefits seem distant but expose a common task. An appeals body needs examination of its reach over decisions; eligibility standards need examination of their reach into lives. The institution's provision of a name cannot establish that a person's route actually exists or remains usable.

These essays do not settle every dispute, or promise agreement once structures become visible. Effects need investigation, rules need design, and cases need judgment. Nor does not finding an identical account in examined literature establish originality or a solved problem. The limits belong alongside the commitments.

The workshop owner closing the shop and the worker sitting beside his mother may lack the output a form expects. Neither should disappear into you can choose or not eligible. Follow those phrases through to what the person can leave, what remains secure, and whether the next step can still genuinely be their own.

body_hant: 「不滿意，可以不在這裡賣。」虛構的通衢市集這樣回答一家小作坊。話沒有假到讓人無話可說：作坊確實能關店，也確實關了。可一年後，營業額只剩原來的三成。門是開著的，離開是不是仍算一條可用的路？
在這個故事裡，通衢既提供市場，也賣自己的商品。同類商品價格與評分接近，自家品牌卻更常上首頁；只有用自家物流，才能進入「快送」欄。平台不只是一個參與競爭的賣家，還安排了別人怎樣參加競爭。這裡的公司與資料均為設例，不是對現實平台的調查結論。
有人主張把市場與自營分開，防止一邊定規則一邊參賽；有人提醒，自家物流與商品可能改善服務，不能不看效果一律禁止。兩邊抓住的，都不只是情緒。可即使消費者買得更便宜，也還沒有答完賣家能不能問規則；結構有衝突，也不自動說明拆分是唯一答案。
先看繞不繞得過去。名義上還有別的平台，不等於那些地方接得住他的生意。要查真實的替代、遷移與生計條件。越接近不可繞開的地方，越需要強的約束與追問；離得遠一些，也不是從此不用負責。
再看誰能關門。暫停帳號、推遲結算、取消入口，可能讓一家人的生活突然停住。這樣的決定不能成為一個位置獨佔、別人永遠不能再問的終點。有管理權限，不等於把收窄權限與處理異議的權力也全部握在一起。
第三看問到哪裡。在故事裡，申訴委員會七人中有五人由管理層任命。僅憑這個來源，還不能斷定沒有獨立性；要查誰能啟動，啟動後有什麼實際效力，平台能否撤人、斷經費、扣資料、取消審查，或報復提出問題的人。
第四看平台能給別人定多大的規則。排序、準入、結算與申訴，落在許多人的生活上；它可以就哪些事項立規、立到哪裡，應當有制度劃出的範圍，不由它自己單方面擴張。不是每一條經營規則都要事先報批，而是不能自己決定自己權限的全部邊界。
後來，通衢董事會把兩個由賣家互選的申訴席位，也改成管理層任命。人員安排可以修訂，不等於修訂的通道也可由被問者單獨把持。別處是否仍有獨立、能發動、不受報復的路，要實際找到，不能用「架構調整」把它省掉。
照這四樣看，議會刪掉請求拆分的條款，本身不足以斷定失職。保留排序公開與獨立申訴，也不足以證明問題已經解決。若這兩項實際做不成所需的約束，就繼續問缺在哪裡；不能把一種工具的名字，當作結果已經發生。
拆分可以是手段，但在這裡被放在最後：較輕的安排不足，或有充分根據認為它們做不成這些條件，才動用，並說明處理哪一處封路、損失什麼、有什麼替代。無需先讓四項都已實現才能拆，也不必等再受一次傷害；否則「最後」就成了永遠不會到的以後。
這些原則偏向事前安排，卻沒有替每個平台報出「拆」或「不拆」。這確實不是爭論者想要的全部答案。具體效果、網路聯繫的損失與工具的代價，仍要認真算；留給具體制度做的事，不是免做，只是不假裝一個總原則已替它做完。
市場之外，另一張名單正等著人。青窯在虛構故事裡關閉兩條窯線，裁掉九百人。州勞動廳提供失業金、可任選的培訓補貼，以及遷居和創業支持；不要求進入指定行業。基金會給得更多：三年生活費，但要進入它的設計園，從它定的三條路裡選。
後者還寫了不得去其他瓷器企業工作的條件。這項禁止去向，須照前篇的底線獨立審，不能被較多生活費遮過去。單看園區與培訓條件能否自願接受，也要先查：拒絕以後，基本生活是否仍有實際著落。州另列一份支持，還沒有證明每個人都已被托住。
救濟附不附條件，兩邊也都有能說出來的理由。一邊說，分享社會產出就應作貢獻；另一邊說，人需要說不的力量。若這點生計最後換成必須走別人指定的路，錢雖然來了，方向卻一並交走了。
這裡先不把領取者理解成欠了一份回報。基本保障不因他還沒交出成就，就失去根據。若財政、執行與具體安排確實做得到，無須附條件更好；做不到時，可以討論某些通用要求，但只是對現實困難的讓步，不是讓人在道德上先還債。
「做不到」也需要證據。附上條件以後，有限的資源是否真正接住了該接住的人，要看實際。把仍有需要的人擠出名單，帳上省了一筆，不叫保障改善。財政能不能辦到，與附上的條件有沒有越線，要分開核；困難不發放越線許可。
登記求職、接受相當工作、學習或培訓，可以作為具體討論的通用要求；做哪行、學哪項，仍要有人自己可選。紙面列了好幾類，手邊實際卻只有一條路、拒絕就失去全部保障，那並沒有保住選擇。
基本保障薄，不推出要求可以越來越多。保障多厚，也不能獨自決定能否無條件給付；財政與執行條件都要核。方向是把條件做得更能托住人，盡可能不再要求，不是等人窮到走不動了，才把他安排得更緊。
現在看九百人中的一位。設想他的母親失智，他留在鎮上照護她。州的續領規則只列登記求職、上學與培訓。他沒有求職，也沒在上課，按名單便不合格。可他每天正在做的事，為什麼在這裡忽然不算了？
照護是他自己選擇的一條往下走的路，也是實際的工作。有無工資，並不決定它是不是「做」。他維持另一個人的生活與尊嚴，恰恰在承擔基本保障本來要接住的事；若條件是為了讓有限資源托住人，這種工作尤其不該被列舉漏掉。
社區裡的工作也一樣。沒有雇傭合同，不等於沒有工作；沒有工資條，也不等於沒有經濟貢獻。承認這些，不是給他補發一張「值得領救濟的好人」證，而是改掉一份太窄的名單：原來它把有價值的活動，錯認成了什麼也沒做。
把照護與志願活動算作參與，並非新的發明。已有的參與收入討論，就試著把有酬就業之外的活動納入。在這裡，基本保障仍不以報答社會為根據；相同的一項活動，可以被認真承認，而不把領取資格重新綁回他欠了別人多少。
認得寬，不代表事情自動好辦。照護怎樣記錄，做不到怎樣認定，爭議由誰複核，都會產生新的工作。認可機構不能又把門縮到只剩它安排的那一種活動。文字裡有幾個選項，還要核人是否真的夠得著。
生病、殘障或一時實在什麼都做不了的人，不能因無法滿足活動要求而失去基本保障。條件只向實際能做到的人問。若一整類人都夠不著，問題是條件沒有給出，不該逼他們每人單獨證明自己為什麼例外。
規則漏到的個別處境，需要有人現場判斷；制度自己造出的缺口，則由制度說明並修正。不能把全部修補責任塞給申請者，再誇讚少數人終於申訴成功。需要幫助的人已經在承擔生活，不該還替壞規則永久承擔額外的一份。
同樣，不能只憑「背景不公」四個字，就替每一個人預先判定任何條件都不適用。做不做得到、條件本身合不合邊界，要具體看；已經越線的條件先改，不能要求照辦。沒有被名單接住的人，也不能因此被放下。
平台與福利看起來很遠，卻讓同一個問題浮出來。平台說有申訴機構，得繼續問它夠不夠得著決定；福利說有領取標準，得繼續問它有沒有接住生活。組織提供了一個名稱，不等於人的路已經在。
這組討論不給每一場爭論一錘定音。它也不保證結構一展開，所有人就認同。利益需要算，規則需要劃，個案需要判斷；更沒有從暫未在文獻中看到同樣說法，就推出自己首創、已經解決的問題。
那位店主關上店鋪，那位窯工坐在母親床邊，可能都暫時沒有報表期待的成績。不能因此把他們壓成一句「可以選擇」或「不合條件」。要做的，是走到那句話後面，看他還能離開什麼，保有什麼，又有沒有機會自己決定下一步。
